definitions.explanation: An indirect indication of something, communicating meaning without stating it explicitly.
In psychology, the process of influencing thoughts or behavior through indirect means.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{言葉|ことば}には{暗示|あんじ}が{含|ふく}まれていた。
{将来|しょうらい}を{暗示|あんじ}する{出来事|できごと}だった。
examples.english: It was an event that hinted at the future.

examples.japanese: {自己暗示|じこあんじ}で{緊張|きんちょう}をほぐす。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{暗|あん} (dark, implicit) + {示|じ} (show, indicate) - showing implicitly

USAGE:
Can describe:
・Hidden meanings in words or actions
・Foreshadowing in stories
・Psychological suggestion

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{自己暗示|じこあんじ} - self-suggestion, autosuggestion
・{暗示|あんじ}にかかる - to be susceptible to suggestion

COLLOCATIONS:
・{暗示|あんじ}を{与|あた}える - to give a hint
・{暗示|あんじ}に{富|と}む - to be full of suggestions/implications

RELATED:
・{含|ふく}み - implication, undertone
・{婉曲|えんきょく} - euphemism
・ほのめかす - to hint, suggest
